input: X11 XTest mouse and keyboard events
passed: Moving from suggestions to the native Status list closes the old popup without focus errors
Enter saves an existing ledger amount once; Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y reverse and restore the field
Top fields save on click-away and Tab; each completed field has one undo step
Selecting another row saves the completed existing field without a prompt or duplicate history entry
Repeat copies date, seconds, status, notes, tags and all other fields; selecting a row silently discards its draft
Add Flow inserts a repeated draft once and resets the form; undo and redo preserve the new record's identity
Moving between new-flow fields keeps the draft; selecting an existing row forgets it without creating records
A full timestamp in the Date cell saves to the second without a separate Save button
Account suggestions and new names save cleanly; undo/redo never reopens a dropdown
Category and comma-containing tags save through the same ledger editing gesture
The native Status list saves a selected choice and does not leave a stale cell editor
Ledger and expanded Notes save multiline text; closing the expansion saves once and undo restores the prior note
Invalid amounts remain unsaved with visible feedback; Escape restores the saved value without a confirmation
No-op completion adds no history; Ctrl+Z first abandons an unfinished field, then undoes the saved edit
Filtering away an edited row saves the correct record and closes its cell overlay
Sorting and native wheel scrolling save edits without leaving a cell editor on the wrong row
Window resizing keeps the editor aligned or closes it; New Flow completes an existing edit and clears the form
Void needs no confirmation and can be undone and redone for the current session
All custom popups first map at their final position; field completion leaves no reopened suggestions
